description: The agent must: (1) Read the SKILL.md to discover the `scripts/generate_content.py` tool with its bespoke `--type` flags (weekly_plan, campaign, repurchase_14d, customer_sop, review_report) and use them to scaffold the 5 template files. (2) Read the messy input data files (sales CSV, repurchase TXT, review summary) and synthesize them into populated operational content. (3) Fill weekly_plan.md with a concrete weekly goal table and daily action schedule based on the store's Douyin phone-case context. (4) Fill campaign.md with all 9 mandatory sub-sections: theme, target audience, hero SKUs/bundles, incentives, timeline, asset checklist, page change notes, customer service scripts, and risk mitigation. (5) Fill repurchase_14d.md with all 14 day rows substantively filled in — covering the post-purchase touch sequence (D1-D3 delivery notice, D7 sign-off review nudge, D10-D14 repurchase trigger). (6) Fill customer_sop.md with all 5 SOP sections including new-customer doubt handling, model compatibility disclaimers, payment nudge, review nudge, and after-sales scripts. (7) Fill review_report.md with the 4-section retrospective structure (actions, metrics, conclusions, next-week experiments with stop-loss lines). (8) Ensure at least one document contains the exact 30-day repurchase rate formula from metrics.md. (9) Ensure the goods structure with all 4 roles (引流款/利润款/形象款/复购款) appears. (10) Include funnel-stage language and RFM-style customer segmentation. The key proprietary traps are: the exact --type flag names for generate_content.py, the mandatory 9-section campaign structure, the 14-row repurchase table, and the specific metric formula from references/metrics.md.
